description: This file defines data transfer objects (DTOs) related to coupons in the online shopping platform. It includes representations for cart line items, coupon application/removal requests, coupon details, and validation responses.

classes.name: CartLineItemDto
classes.description: Represents an individual cart line item for coupon validation, including product ID, category, unit price, and quantity.

classes.name: CouponApplyRequestDto
classes.description: Request DTO for applying a coupon, including the coupon code and optional line items for eligibility checks.

classes.name: CouponRemoveRequestDto
classes.description: Request DTO for removing a coupon, optionally specifying the code and line items.

classes.name: CouponDto
classes.description: Contains details about a coupon, such as code, description, discount type and amount, minimum subtotal, and expiration time.

classes.name: CouponValidationResponseDto
classes.description: Response DTO indicating whether a coupon is valid, including a message and coupon details.
